title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (TypeScript / Node.js)
description: Hi, we are Storyteq! Storyteq helps marketing and creative teams in top brands scale their creative production and gain control over their marketing campaigns. Through our platform, our clients streamline campaign workflows, automate their creative production through templates and AI, and activate engaging campaigns that go to market faster. We believe creativity takes time, but creative production shouldn’t. Since 2016 our mission has been to revolutionize the way creative assets are created and used. Magic happens when we let technology empower creativity. Our endless curiosity and relentless commitment to our customers lies at the heart of our problem-solving approach. This shared mission is woven into our values: we dream big, think differently, and are stronger together. About the job: About the job You will be part of the Templating domain, where we enable global enterprises to scale up their content creation efficiently. Content comes in from sources like Photoshop, Figma and After Effects, or is designed in our AI-enabled, web-based editor, and then taken to the next level. You will work directly with other developers, designers, quality engineers, DevOps engineers and product owners to deliver the best platform for our users. This is a full stack role with TypeScript and Node.js at its core. Most of your time goes into backend services, APIs and data models, and you are just as comfortable picking up a Vue.js frontend task when the feature needs it. You don’t hand work over a wall between backend and frontend: you take a feature from the data model to the screen. AI is part of how we build and part of what we build. You use AI coding assistants and agents in your daily work, and you help shape how AI-powered capabilities reach our product. We want people who embrace it, measure what it gives us, and stay in charge of the quality of what ships. The team works with strong goals and a good balance of product and engineering roadmap work, so we keep both our technology and our product on track. Key responsibilities Build and ship robust backend services and frontends with real product impact Ensure systems are scalable, performant and easy to maintain Model business domains into clean, performant data structures Collaborate across teams to integrate services and deliver end-to-end value Coach and mentor other engineers on best practices to help them grow Collaborate with other engineers and lead technical delivery on initiatives within a domain or project Lead by example in engineering excellence, pragmatism and shared ownership Requirements What we’re looking for Must have: 5+ years of hands-on, production experience delivering full-stack products with TypeScript and JavaScript, with Node.js as your main backend A positive attitude to AI, backed by experience: you already use AI tools and agents in your daily work, and you want to push the team further with them. If you are sceptical of AI, or would rather protect your team from it, this isn’t the right job for you. Core: Hands-on experience with Vue.js (or another modern frontend framework), and no fear of working in the frontend Solid experience designing and integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs Proficiency in data modeling and working with SQL and NoSQL databases Comfortable working in monorepo environments and modular architectures Familiar with testing practices, performance tuning and scalable design principles Confident in making architectural decisions and communicating trade-offs Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English You are proactive, result-driven, and excited to work in a fast-growing tech scale-up What makes you senior for this role: You own outcomes, not just tasks, and see work through from problem to production. You make the architectural calls in your domain and explain the trade-offs clearly. You make the people around you better through reviews, mentoring and the standards you set. Nice to have: Experience with PHP (Laravel). Part of our platform runs on it, but it is not what this job is about Experience building features on top of LLMs or other AI services Experience with GitLab CI/CD, DevOps and public cloud (like GCP) We Value Diversity: We champion and welcome diversity in our workforce and ensure all job applicants receive equal and fair treatment, regardless of age, race, gender or gender identity, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or nationality. We are not only committed to increasing the visibility and recognition of talent from under-represented groups within our organisation but the wider industry too. At the end of the day, we make sure we take time to look after ourselves, each other, and the planet because we’re always stronger together. ITG have a number of community groups (ERGs) available to employees which offer a safe space for like-minded colleagues, with shared interests to connect, socialise and check in with each other. These include Black ITGers Together, LGBTQ+ Together, Mens Health Together, Muslims Together, Neurodiversity Together, Working Parents and Carers Together and Women In Tech Together. #LI-NW1 Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
